title: Demo Services Group | Weekly Executive Update - December 5, 2025
executive_summary: Demo Services Group continues strategic initiatives across governance, platform development, and operational excellence. Key progress includes E6 governance document completion, platform releases (ShiftIQ and Executive Summary), and Coast 2026 renewal justification. Operational focus remains on environment stability and external access enablement.

key_highlights.title: Coast 2026 Renewal – Critical Path
key_highlights.value: Owners: Robert Rossetti, Mario Batiz | Status: Justifying renewal for >$400K BU spending. Platform team and previous budget owners impacted by latest RIF. Working to establish new sponsorship and governance framework.

key_highlights.title: E6 / International Issuing Hub Governance
key_highlights.value: Status: Completed | Governance document finalized and in legal review with Christian Battelley. Establishes shared-asset controls, edit pathways, and reporting obligations.

key_highlights.title: ShiftIQ Platform
key_highlights.value: Status: Release Phase | Shift-management and audit platform launched due to Shift Governance issue with India Ops. Provides enhanced visibility and control over Demo Operations shift scheduling.

key_highlights.title: Executive Summary Platform
key_highlights.value: Status: Release Phase | Automated reporting engine increasing executive and leadership visibility on Demo Services initiatives, processes, and data. Standardizes weekly and monthly reporting.
